contradictions.evidence_a_claim: GPTW 81% say great place to work
contradictions.justification: GPTW measures workplace culture broadly; Glassdoor reflects management effectiveness specifically. Both valid for different subcaps.
contradictions.resolution_rule: Weight both — GPTW measures different dimension than Glassdoor

contradictions.evidence_b_claim: Yelp 1.5/5 from 104 reviews, fraud dept failures
contradictions.justification: P2C3 specifically measures service quality and member experience, where Yelp data is directly relevant. Forbes recognition applies to P4C1 (product competitiveness).
contradictions.resolution_rule: Forbes measures rates/products; Yelp measures service experience. Different dimensions.

contradictions.evidence_a_claim: VP Marketing published AI paper in Journal of Digital Banking
contradictions.evidence_b_claim: Explorium T1 confirms ZERO AI/ML platforms deployed
contradictions.justification: Scoring measures deployed capability, not awareness. VP awareness is scored under P1C3 (innovation evaluation) not P2C4 (personalization deployment).
contradictions.resolution_rule: Presence != Utilization. Academic awareness does not equal deployment.
